definitions.explanation: One of the three states of matter, where molecules move freely and fill any container.

examples.japanese: ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{蒸発|じょうはつ}して→蒸発する：07651_jouhatsu⟧{気体|きたい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Water evaporates and becomes a gas.

examples.japanese: ⟦{酸素|さんそ}→酸素：02830_sanso⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{無色|むしょく}→無色：22467_mushoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{気体|きたい}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
⟦{固体|こたい}→固体：14852_kotai⟧、⟦{液体|えきたい}→液体：04134_ekitai⟧、{気体|きたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{三態|さんたい}→三態：noentry⟧
examples.english: The three states of matter: solid, liquid, and gas.

notes:
{気体|きたい} is the scientific term for gas as a state of matter, referring to a substance whose molecules move freely and expand to fill any container.

STATES OF MATTER:
- ⟦{固体|こたい}→固体：14852_kotai⟧: solid
- ⟦{液体|えきたい}→液体：04134_ekitai⟧: liquid
- {気体|きたい}: gas

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {気体|きたい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become a gas (change of state)
- {気体|きたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧: gaseous state
- {気体|きたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}させる→発生：03133_hassei⟧: to generate a gas

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {気体|きたい}: gas (scientific, academic contexts)
- ⟦ガス→ガス：01344_gasu⟧: gas (loanword, everyday use; also cooking gas, natural gas)
- ⟦{蒸気|じょうき}→蒸気：04278_jouki⟧: steam, vapor (specifically the gaseous form of water or other liquids)

REGISTER:
Used primarily in science, education, and technical writing. In everyday life, ガス is more common.
